title: Special Executive Programme In Leadership Development And Performance Management
description: The course aims to develop leadership skills and enhance performance management techniques to drive employee engagement and organizational success.
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of leadership development and performance management by focusing on employee engagement, talent management, and communication skills. Participants will explore key theories, models, and practices to elevate organizational performance through effective leadership and teamwork.
courseDetails: Strong leadership, motivation, teamwork, and communication skills are critical for achieving high performance in any organization. Employee performance and organizational performance are interlinked and can be enhanced through effective leadership, teamwork, and communication. Understanding group dynamics, team roles, motivation theories, and communication models can help overcome communication barriers and improve team performance. The Quad Model of Talent Management. Effective Talent Management. Importance of performance management – in theory and practice. The purpose and nature of the performance management process. The contribution of Performance Management to employees, managers and the organisation functions. The concept and purpose of performance management systems. Participants will gain insights into the intricacies of employee engagement, its measurement, and the application of continuous performance management tools. Additionally, the course will cover motivational theories, teamwork dynamics, and the significance of communication in fostering high performance. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Leadership and Management Development Programmes: The Role of Motivation Teamwork and Communication in Leadership: Effective Talent and Performance Management:
